# VitaCoat

> VitaCoat is presented as a surface coating for hard, non-porous, high-touch surfaces. It supplements routine cleaning and disinfection. Current technical documentation and project review govern any product-performance, safety, or regulatory claim.

## Language architecture
- Norwegian commercial root: https://www.vitacoat.no/
- English international layer: https://www.vitacoat.no/en/
- The website uses explicit crawlable URLs, visible language switching, reciprocal language alternates, and no automatic IP or browser-language redirect as the primary multilingual mechanism.

## Preferred search language
- Norwegian: antimikrobielt belegg, hygienebelegg, antimikrobiell coating, hygienisk overflatebehandling, berøringsflater, dokumentasjon, testing og standarder.
- English: antimicrobial coating, coating for high-touch surfaces, hygienic surface coating, healthcare touch surfaces, food-processing non-food-contact surfaces, technical documentation, testing and standards.

## Important claim boundaries
- VitaCoat supplements routine cleaning and disinfection; it does not replace them.
- VitaCoat is positioned for hard, non-porous surfaces.
- Direct-food-contact approval should not be assumed.
- Project-specific fit should be confirmed through technical review and documentation.

## Entity and publisher
- VitaCoat is the product/brand presented on this site.
- Legal website publisher and technical-commercial entity: NanoTech Solutions Norway AS, organisation no. 925 367 869.
- Registered business address: Hofslundveien 6, N-3090 Hof, Norway.
- Manufacturer/formulation provenance should be taken from controlled product documentation, not inferred from website publisher information.

## Current VitaCoat identity and evidence provenance
- Current marketed product name: VitaCoat.
- Current VitaCoat company attribution: NanoTech Solutions Norway AS, Hofslundveien 6, N-3090 Hof, Norway.
- Citrox/Citrox Protect are historical source names used when tracing older documentation.
- Preserve original laboratory report IDs, samples, dates, signatories, issuer and client/sponsor metadata.
- The 2020 and 2022 evidence campaigns are separate; overlapping conclusions do not establish formulation equivalence.
- Formulation equivalence, historical report reassignment/rebranding rights, current SDS/regulatory status, and public claim scope require controlled technical review.
